researcher: claude-code (manual: web search, page fetches, curl, public APIs). No paid database was used.
how_to_read: Each fact is something a human researcher found in about 90 minutes with a browser. `match` is a cheap machine check run by scripts/intel_gap.py against everything the tool stored for the company (lower-cased text; Python regexes). `all` = every pattern must hit, `any` = at least one must. A match proves the tool holds the information, not that it is shown or correct; `weight` says how much it matters for deciding whether and how to approach the company (3 = decisive, 2 = important, 1 = useful). `closed_by` lists the roadmap tickets that must make the tool capture it. `grade` follows diagnosis/contracts.py (A filed/official, B company's own publication, C third party, D inference).

facts.claim: Legal name Asco Filtri S.p.A., VAT / tax code 02688370135, REA MI-1692282.
Registered office and plant: Viale delle Scienze 8, 20082 Binasco (MI). HQ moved to Binasco in 2013 (earlier in the Milan area).
Share capital EUR 2,500,000 fully paid.
Incorporated 5 August 2002 (the company site also says founded in 2002 in Milan by filtration experts).
ATECO 28.29.91, manufacture of apparatus for filtering and purifying liquids and gases for non-domestic use.
Published e-mail channels: ascoinfo@mottcorp.com (company site) and info@ascofiltri.com (directory); certified mail (PEC) ascofiltri@pec.it.
100% of the share capital is held by Mott Corporation (Farmington, Connecticut, USA), a foreign precision-filtration manufacturer.
Mott acquired ASCO on 13 January 2022 (Mott's own site dates it 2021: sources conflict); ASCO trades as 'ASCO Filtri: A Mott Company'.

Ultimate parent is IDEX Corporation (NYSE: IEX, Illinois): IDEX bought Mott on 5 Sep 2024 (about USD 982M net cash), and its FY2024 and FY2025 10-K Exhibit 21 list 'Asco Filtri SpA, Italy' among its subsidiaries.
facts.notes: AIDA already holds this (controlling_shareholders: MOTT level 1, IDEX CORP level 2), so the data exists; what is missing is anything that acts on it (see OW-06).

facts.claim: Before Mott, ASCO was bought in July 2019 by the private-equity club deal Red-Fish Kapital (100% through newco AF srl / AFI srl); managers Michelini and Mascheroni reinvested.
At the 2019 deal ASCO had FY2018 revenue EUR 19.9M, EBITDA EUR 1.9M, net financial position EUR 191k.

Consequence for targeting: ASCO is a controlled subsidiary of a US listed group, not an independent Mittelstand-type owner-managed firm; decision rights sit outside Italy. The tool must flag this (today it only lists the shareholders; across the 953 companies 533 have a corporate holder of 50% or more and 139 are 50%+ foreign-owned, though a corporate holder can also be a family holding).

Timeline from the company's own history: 2002 founded; 2004-2006 branches in France then Mexico; 2013 new HQ in Binasco; 2022 Mott deal and Asco Filtration Trading Ltd (Abu Dhabi); 2023 ASCORP Energies India Pvt Ltd (Pune); 2024 IDEX acquires Mott; 2025 fully automated filter-element production facility in Italy.
2025: opened a fully automated filter-element production facility in Italy (company-stated; no independent confirmation found, so verify before using in outreach).
Ennio Michelini (Managing Director/CEO 2019-2022) may no longer hold the role (MarketScreener profile): a leadership-change lead to verify.
Latest accounts (AIDA): revenue about EUR 28.8M, EBIT margin about 10%, 68 employees.
sources: AIDA export held in the tool

facts.claim: Mott Corporation CEO at the 2022 deal: Boris Levin.
Makes engineered process filtration for oil and gas / petrochemical, fine chemical, water treatment, clean energy (hydrogen), food and beverage, and pharmaceutical / healthcare.
Has a separate Engineering Division for customised engineered solutions; Mott's range adds skids, spargers and coalescers.

Twelve product-family manuals are published as PDFs (IOMS-BFL, BTF, CPV, HCR/HCD, HF/LF, MCR, MT, SCR/SCD, SCT, STF/BFF, STR/BFR, VCR/VCT): the real product families are in the documents, not on the web pages.
Historically acted as Mott's authorised representative / distribution partner for Europe, Middle East and Africa before the acquisition.
ISO 9001:2015 (certificate file name suggests validity to 29 Jun 2026: check for renewal) and ISO 45001:2018 (Accredia, Nov 2024).
Pressure-equipment credentials: PED Module H and H1 certificates (notified body CE 1370), ASME U-Stamp 2026-2029 and National Board registration.
Achilles supplier-qualification certificates (Silver level, incl. Middle East and Africa network): ASCO is pre-qualified for oil-and-gas operator supply chains.
Foreign footprint: branches in France and Mexico (2004-2006), Asco Filtration Trading Ltd in Abu Dhabi (2022), ASCORP Energies India Pvt Ltd in Pune (2023).
Hydrogen ecosystem: member of H2IT (Italian hydrogen association) and listed in the EU IPCEI Hydrogen matchmaking directory (entry updated 2026-07-08).
Trade fairs: ACHEMA 2015 (Frankfurt, Hall 5 Stand C18) shared with Mott.
Company LinkedIn page: it.linkedin.com/company/asco-filtri-s.p.a.
Website runs on Microsoft IIS 10 with ASP.NET MVC (headers 'Server: Microsoft-IIS/10.0', 'X-Powered-By: ASP.NET'); no CMS. The tool's tech detector reported 'absent' (false negative).

Site-quality defects visible to a visitor: placeholder 'John Doe / Monica Doe' text, statistic counters that render 0, typos; no careers page. A proof the web presence is unmanaged since the group takeover.
No careers page and no vacancy found on the company site or in a web search (a confirmed absence, not a gap).
Named peers on directory sites: MP Filtri, Stilmas, Unidro, Filtrex, Brofind, Cannon Artes, Pentair Manufacturing Italy (suggest-only: a human confirms).
The site publishes 21 downloadable PDFs: 9 certificates and 12 product manuals.
